en-US.description:
IFCDC Barbers makes it easy to book professional barbershop appointments. Browse real haircut and style photos, choose your service, pick a barber and time, and pay securely with PayPal.

Features:
• Book appointments with live availability
• View service photos and style gallery before you book
• Secure PayPal checkout and email confirmations
• AURA assistant for quick booking help
• Manage your profile and booking history

Official app for IFCDC Barbers — smart booking powered by real style photos.

APP REVIEW NOTES — Build 54 (Version 1.1.2)

Review Account:
Email: apple.review@ifcdcbarbersapp.com
Password: IFCDC-Review2026!

What's new in Build 54:
• Rate Me and Rewards load reliably with improved session handling
• Time-off days correctly block booking slots
• Provider My Schedule shows client details
• PayPal checkout and booking flow stability improvements
• Authentication and network retry fixes

Customer booking flow (required):
Home → Book → select provider → service → time → PayPal checkout (live payments on production backend).

Rate Me / Rewards:
Profile → Rate Me (reviews after completed visits)
Profile → Rewards (points balance and redemption)

Registration test:
Create Account → choose language and provider type → enter phone → complete signup.

Admin (optional):
Sign in with review account if configured as platform admin → Admin tab → Barber management.

Account Deletion:
Profile → Delete Account → Type DELETE → Confirm
